1cffad0 /* Find the least cost intra mode for 32 8x8 macroblocks per workgroup
1cffb19 * Loads 33 macroblocks plus the pixels directly above them into local memory,
1cffb67 * padding where necessary with edge pixels.  It then cooperatively calculates
1cffbb5 * smoothed top and left pixels for use in some of the analysis.
1cffbf7 * Then groups of 32 threads each calculate a single intra mode for each 8x8
1cffc43 * block.  Since consecutive threads are calculating the same intra mode there
1cffc91 * is no code-path divergence.  8 intra costs are calculated simultaneously.  If
1cffce1 * the "slow" argument is not zero, the final two (least likely) intra modes are
1cffd31 * tested in a second pass.  The slow mode is only enabled for presets slow,
1cffd7d * slower, and placebo.
1cffd96 * This allows all of the pixels functions to read pixels from local memory, and
1cffde6 * avoids re-fetching edge pixels from global memory.  And it allows us to
1cffe30 * calculate all of the intra mode costs simultaneously without branch divergence.
1cffe84 * Local dimension:    [ 32, 8 ]
1cffea4 * Global dimensions:  [ paddedWidth, height ] */

1d00c34 atom_min( &cost_buf[lx], satd );

1d00cb3 fenc_intra_cost[gidy * mb_width + gx] = cost_buf[lx]+ 5*lambda;
